subject: Discovery follow-up: propose rotating demo windows for CloudWell technical deep dive
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emily Hart <emily.hart@cloudwell.io>, Rajiv Kumar <rkumar@cloudwell.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery follow-up: propose rotating demo windows for CloudWell technical deep dive

Emily / Rajiv — thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

Recap (2 min):
- Goal: validate latency/cost profile for multi-tenant inference and discuss private deployment (VPC) + KMS flow.
- Key attendees we recommended: Cloud architect, security lead, and one infra engineer from CloudWell; from Redwood: myself (sales), Grace (solutions), Marissa (RTE).

Ask / next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive where we:
1) Walk through a short replay of the discovery findings (10 min)
2) Demo a representative request pattern and show live perf numbers (25–30 min)
3) Deep-dive on VPC/keys/network & SLA questions (25–30 min)

Because your team is distributed, we propose a rotating weekly slot pattern so the same core Redwood + CloudWell stakeholders can join without repeatedly forcing inconvenient times. Below are three rotation options — each is a 90-minute slot that rotates week-to-week across US / EU / APAC-friendly windows. All times include examples in local zones to make calendar invites easier.

Rotation Option A — Monday weekly rotation (fast ramp)
- Week 1 (US-friendly): Mon 09:00–10:30 PT / 12:00–13:30 ET / 17:00–18:30 BST
- Week 2 (EU-friendly): Mon 10:00–11:30 BST / 05:00–06:30 PT / 14:00–15:30 SGT
- Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Mon 16:00–17:30 SGT / 08:00–09:30 BST / 00:00–01:30 PT

Rotation Option B — Midweek swing (less US-night)
- Week 1 (US/early EU): Wed 11:00–12:30 ET / 16:00–17:30 BST / 23:00–00:30 SGT
- Week 2 (EU/APAC): Wed 15:00–16:30 BST / 23:00–00:30 SGT / 10:00–11:30 PT

Single-week alternative (if rotation is too heavy): choose a single recurring slot optimized for the next 4 weeks and then reassess.

Practical notes:
- We can send ICS invites for all candidate slots and mark tentative availability; attendees can accept the ones that work.
- If CloudWell wants to restrict who rotates (e.g., only architects rotate, security sits on EU weeks), we can tailor the cadence.

Attachments: discovery-notes-cloudwell.pdf (brief notes), proposed-rotational-slots.ics (proposed invite skeleton).

Please let me know: 1) which rotation option you prefer (A / B / single-week), 2) any absolute no-go days/times for the next 4 weeks, and 3) who from your side should be on the invite for the first session (name + role).

If helpful I can also draft a mutual action plan after we lock the date.

Thanks — feel free to reply with the best option and I'll issue tentative invites.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189


From: Emily Hart <emily.hart@cloudwell.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <rkumar@cloudwell.io>, CloudWell IT <it@cloudwell.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 18:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: propose rotating demo windows for CloudWell technical deep dive

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful, and the rotation idea sounds promising. A few constraints from our side: 

- Security lead (Anita Shah) is generally unavailable on Mondays before 14:00 BST.
- Our primary infra architect (Rajiv) prefers earlier EU windows (09:00–12:00 BST) but can flex twice per month for APAC-friendly slots.
- We’d like the first session to include our Cloud Architect (Emily Hart), Rajiv (Infra), and one person from Security (Anita) — Anita will join if the slot is EU-friendly.

Preference: Option B looks closest to our needs if we start with a Wed slot in an EU/early-US time to maximize participation this month. Specifically, can you propose two candidate Wednesdays in the next three weeks with times matching: Wed 15:00–16:30 BST (which is Wed 10:00–11:30 ET)?

Also, please keep the invite to a max of 6 internal Redwood/CloudWell people for the first session — we can expand later.

If you send the tentative ICS options I’ll confirm internally and get back with any absolute no-gos.

Best,
Emily
Emily Hart | Cloud Architect
CloudWell
emily.hart@cloudwell.io

- Wed 2026-07-29 15:00–16:30 BST (10:00–11:30 ET)
